descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92581 AC 3; UAT TC-03 ER · “There is no diagnosis on the Nursing Home card or in Nursing Home search”.

Bug B28 · S2 · known

Nursing Home cards show the diagnosis and Nursing Home search matches on diagnosis (the spec says neither)

Tickets: TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa; TFA-92579 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): AC 3 of TFA-92579 says the diagnosis shows on Hospital cards only, so TC-01/S02 and the Nursing Home diagnosis cells of TC-01/S03 and S26 fail on it too.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S02, TC-03/S07, TC-21/S16

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S09 Card per context: Hospital card has the diagnosis, Nursing Home card and search hint have none

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Nursing Home has no diagnosis: none on the Nursing Home card, and Nursing Home search does not match on diagnosis. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture ({snfResident} has an MRN 'MRN-<6 chars>' and a stored diagnosis, no unit, no facility)

When Open the Hospital list, then the Nursing Home list in Today's Visits and in All Residents, with no search

Then Hospital card shows the diagnosis. The Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis, and the untouched NH search hint does not offer diagnosis, in both views

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain {hospitalPatient}, 'Community-acquired pneumonia'. cp2 and cp3 mustContain {snfResident}, 'MRN-' (anchors only, not U6 evidence: 'MRN-' would match any MRN text). They mustNotContain 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture', {hospitalPatient} and the word 'diagnosis' (U5). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92581 ready for qa

Hospital cards correctly show the diagnosis, but Nursing Home cards show it too, and the Nursing Home search hint mentions 'diagnosis'.

Evidence: dev U01 (ledger #1). Already in dev report §2 #4, cluster C1 (TFA-92581 AC 3). Facility is not checked here: there is no field (S10).

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).
